entries.body:
---
'@anarchitects/auth-contracts': minor
'@anarchitects/identity-contracts': minor
---

Introduce the first Zod-first Auth and Identity HTTP contracts, with inferred
input/output types, 21 operation definitions and dual ESM/CommonJS exports.
Preserve the frozen session/JWT/passkey and profile wire semantics, including
coercion, nullable fields, policy order, cookie obligations and existing operation
IDs. Assign IDs to the three previously undocumented JWT routes; do not restore
the obsolete refresh-tokens endpoint.

These initial development packages do not claim deployment adoption. Request
JSON Schema projection and resolved host security profiles remain release gates
for issue #7; publication and independent conformance remain issue #8. Consumers
must retain their current immutable pins until those gates and their runtime
adoption checks pass. No intentional wire migration is introduced.

---
'@anarchitects/forms-contracts': minor
'@anarchitects/newsletter-contracts': minor
---

Introduce the first Zod-first Forms and Newsletter HTTP contracts with inferred
input/output types, eight operation definitions and dual ESM/CommonJS exports.
Preserve legacy coercion, strict Newsletter input and UTF-16 limits, honeypot
ordering, signed webhook raw-body/header obligations, response/error shapes and
existing operationIds. No new runtime business logic or intended wire migration
is introduced.

These are unreleased development workspaces. Forms D05 (dynamic validation bypass)
and D08 (delivery-secret forwarding) remain explicit stable capability blockers.
Native schema projection and resolved host profiles require #7 decisions before
release; publication and independent conformance remain #8. Consumer adoption
and any validation/redaction migration require separate reviewed Bricks work.

---
'@anarchitects/auth-contracts': minor
'@anarchitects/forms-contracts': minor
'@anarchitects/identity-contracts': minor
'@anarchitects/newsletter-contracts': minor
---

Add explicit generated OpenAPI review JSON/YAML, diagnostic inventories and
version/profile/digest manifest exports. Preserve canonical parsing and wire
behavior. All artifacts remain review-only: bounded projection proposal P07,
unresolved host bindings and Forms D05/D08 prevent release or adoption claims.
Generation, baseline comparison and package-aware compatibility gates do not
replace actual HTTP conformance or #8 publication approval.

---
'@anarchitects/auth-contracts': minor
'@anarchitects/forms-contracts': minor
'@anarchitects/identity-contracts': minor
'@anarchitects/newsletter-contracts': minor
---

Implement scoped P07 projections, faithful representable constraints and strict
host-profile resolution/evidence gates. Preserve explicit capability blockers and
distinguish synthetic verification from release. Add public Forms definition and
administrative delivery-status migration targets without changing frozen routes.
Canonical runtime validation remains mandatory; no deployment evidence is approved.
